subject.title: BL-shipping-costs-02: patrones de differentShippingCosts mal escapados en countries

question: Should this issue be fixed as a controlled data operation plus a small cleanup PR now, or wait for the larger checkout BL draft to be sequenced?
rationale: The source cleanup is small, but the canonical data mutation and BL spec target live partly outside current `dev`, so maintainers need to choose the sequencing and operational owner.

options.title: Fix data now, cleanup with BL draft
options.body: Correct the single Mongo country entry now and coordinate removal of the fallback and spec update when the checkout BL draft is updated.

options.title: Bundle into the checkout BL PR
options.body: Keep the issue open until the draft PR is ready, accepting that raw API consumers may still see the malformed match until then.

options.title: Ship a source-side sanitizer only
options.body: Normalize at the repository/API boundary without touching stored data, but this leaves the owner-validated data debt unresolved.

recommendation.title: Fix data now, cleanup with BL draft
recommendation.body: Correct the single Mongo country entry now and coordinate removal of the fallback and spec update when the checkout BL draft is updated.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the BL split/draft context that records the divergence and can coordinate the renamed spec target.
